technical.summary: Bullish structure with price above all key MAs and trending ADX, but overbought stochastics, weak volume, and hull MA divergence create meaningful pullback risk—suitable for scaled entry only.

fundamental.summary: MPC shows no fundamental conviction signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 12 days present elevated volatility risk with no offsetting smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (26/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; neutral composite signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (325.28) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures energy multinationals, and earnings binary event in 12 days compounds volatility risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with bullish supertrend and trending ADX in extreme fear environment (VIX crisis) creates contrarian entry opportunity near support at 99.628.
debate.key_bear_argument: Stochastics overbought at 84.46, hull MA bearish divergence, weak volume conviction (0.72 ratio), zero fundamental support, and earnings binary event in 12 days within severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, strong dollar) make risk/reward unfavorable.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is bullish with price above all major MAs and trending ADX, but overbought stochastics (84.46) and weak volume conviction (0.72) severely limit entry quality. Contrarian fear opportunity exists, but macro headwinds and earnings binary event in 12 days create asymmetric downside risk.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings volatility in 12 days combined with inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and strong dollar headwinds create binary event risk that negates technical setup; hull MA bearish divergence signals momentum fade into resistance.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated risk and weak conviction
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MPC position with 13 other Energy positions in portfolio; sector concentration and existing ticker exposure reduce conviction further and argue against adding size.
